text: Worth passing to adjuncts: for PSLF, non-tenure-track college faculty get at least 3.35 hours of work credit per credit or contact hour taught, which counts toward full time. Rule: https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/34/685.219
A shared vision holds up best when the people doing the work help write it, adjuncts and classified staff included, and not just by commenting after the draft is finished.
Belongs in every contract: notice before new AI tools arrive, a person accountable for any evaluation, and job protections. Much easier to get in writing before a pilot starts than after.
